title: Round lines or round the total
hook: Rounding three tiny lines separately can differ from rounding their sum once.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Compare line-level rounding with aggregate rounding under a stated convention.

misconception: Rounding before summing is always identical to rounding after summing.
objective: Compare line-level rounding with aggregate rounding under a stated convention.

claims.text: Each fictional line is exactly €0.335 before rounding. A rounds each line to cents; B sums first and rounds once. Scaled model; toy rule: nearest cent, half upward; no billing-law claim.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Lines=3, A=€1.02 and B=€1.01. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*","x",["round",0.335]]; B=["round",["*","x",0.335]]; x denotes Lines. At x=3, A=1.02, B=1.01; recall at x=6: B=2.01. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: Rounding loses information at each application. Three rounded €0.34 lines sum to €1.02, while €1.005 rounded once gives €1.01 under the stated half-up rule. Actual billing conventions need their own rule.

recall.question: Each fictional line is exactly €0.335 before rounding. A rounds each line to cents; B sums first and rounds once. Change only Lines to 6. What is B (Total-once) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Lines=6: it gives €2.01. Rounding loses information at each application. Three rounded €0.34 lines sum to €1.02, while €1.005 rounded once gives €1.01 under the stated half-up rule. Actual billing conventions need their own rule.
